text:
Ravi Shah: who's heading to the Ferry Building farmers market sunday? thinking to grab breakfast + coffee then stroll.
Dana Lee: i was planning on grocery shopping but could swing by for pastries. what time?
Marta: 10am? that gives me time to drop the kids at soccer.
Devon: 10 works. i'd vote for grabbing a table at Blue Bottle after for a quick catch-up.
Ravi Shah: love that. market at 10, coffee at Blue Bottle at 10:45. meet under the clock?
Dana Lee: under the clock it is. i'll bring a tote and cash for the stand that only takes cash.
Marta: also if anyone wants to split a farmer's box i can pick it up — has mixed veg and fruit.
Devon: interested in splitting. how much is the box?
Marta: usually $25-30. vote?
Ravi Shah: vote: split box yes :thumbsup:
Dana Lee: vote yes. can chip in via venmo.
CalendarBot: Event created: "Ferry Bldg market + coffee" Sunday 10:00 AM. Attendees: Ravi Shah, Dana Lee, Marta, Devon.
Devon: optional: bring a reusable cup if you want a discount at Blue Bottle.
Marta: note: if weather turns, fallback plan -> brunch at Plow at 11:30.
Ravi Shah: will post an update Saturday evening if the forecast looks off.
Dana Lee: see you all Sunday! :sparkles: :croissant:
